categories.main_business_segments: Jacobs Solutions Inc. operates two primary business segments: Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities (I&AF), which delivers end-to-end solutions for complex challenges in infrastructure, water, environmental, energy, transportation, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing; and PA Consulting, a majority-owned global innovation and transformation consultancy serving both public and private sector clients across multiple industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Jacobs leverages advanced data and digital capabilities, including artificial intelligence, data analytics, digital architecture, software development, and cybersecurity, to deliver technology-enabled solutions. The company employs a full lifecycle approach from advisory and consulting, feasibility, and planning through design, program delivery, and operations, increasingly integrating digital tools and sustainability frameworks into project execution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jacobs serves a diverse mix of national, state, and local government agencies, as well as multinational and local private sector organizations. Key end markets include advanced manufacturing, cities & places, energy, environmental, life sciences, transportation, and water, with PA Consulting also supporting sectors such as consumer goods, defense, financial services, and health.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in more than 40 countries, with significant presence in the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Middle East, India, Australia, Canada, and Asia Pacific. Approximately 38% of revenue in fiscal 2025 was generated outside the U.S., reflecting a broad international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jacobs primarily operates as a downstream provider in the supply chain, delivering professional services, consulting, engineering, design, project management, and lifecycle solutions directly to end clients. The company also acts as a systems integrator, managing subcontractors and third-party suppliers for project delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Jacobs' strategic focus centers on digitally enabled, resilient solutions for sustainability, critical infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing. The company invests in AI, next-generation digital tools, and sustainability initiatives (e.g., PlanBeyond® and Evolve tool), and pursues growth through innovation, high-value consulting, and strategic partnerships, notably with PA Consulting. R&D efforts emphasize digital transformation, climate resilience, and integrated project delivery.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through a mix of cost-reimbursable (68% in FY25) and fixed-price (32%) contracts for professional services, consulting, engineering, and project delivery. The company also earns revenue from program management, advisory services, and, through PA Consulting, innovation and transformation projects. Contracts are typically billed as work progresses, with payment terms of 30-60 days.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jacobs competes with global engineering, consulting, and technology firms such as AECOM, Tetra Tech, WSP, Arcadis, Bechtel, Arup, Stantec, Parsons, Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, PwC, Bain, and McKinsey. The company is positioned as a leader in science-based consulting and digitally enabled solutions, emphasizing integrated delivery and sustainability, with no single competitor dominating its markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2025, Jacobs reported $12.0 billion in revenue (up 4.6% year-over-year), $2.98 billion in gross profit, and $313 million in net earnings from continuing operations. Backlog reached $23.1 billion, and the company maintains a strong liquidity position with $1.24 billion in cash. The business has shown steady growth in both revenue and operating profit, particularly in I&AF and PA Consulting, though net earnings declined year-over-year due to discontinued operations and one-time charges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jacobs differentiates itself through its integrated, digitally enabled approach to solving complex, large-scale challenges in infrastructure, sustainability, and advanced manufacturing. The company emphasizes end-to-end lifecycle solutions, deep domain expertise, and a strong commitment to sustainability and resilience, leveraging advanced digital tools and strategic partnerships to deliver measurable outcomes and lasting value for clients and communities.
